title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About Levity

Our client, Levity, is a no-code AI automation platform that enables companies to build and deploy AI-powered workflows without needing programming skills. Levity helps teams automate repetitive operational tasks such as processing emails, documents, images, and customer requests by training AI models on their own data. 

Founded in 2018, Levity has raised USD 12MM and is backed by top-leading investors including Balderton Capital, one of Europe’s leading venture capital firms, and Angular Ventures. 

With its HQ in Germany and Chicago, but with a global presence, its platform is designed to make AI accessible to non-technical teams by allowing them to create and deploy automation through a simple visual interface. This enables companies to streamline workflows, reduce manual work, and increase operational efficiency across functions like operations, customer support, and back-office processes. Levity has been greatly used especially by global logistics leading companies. 

In simple terms: Levity allows companies to automate complex business workflows using AI without needing engineers. 


About the role

Levity is hiring their first in‑house Lead Product Designer to own our product experience end‑to‑end and help define how design lives at Levity.


Why this role:

  • You’ll be the foundational product designer Lead at a company where design is already taken seriously.
  • You’ll work directly with the CTO, founders, solutions engineering, commercial/GTM, to shape the product, not just individual screens.
  • You’ll design at the frontier of what’s possible with AI and automation, turning complex workflows into simple, delightful experiences.


What you’ll do:

Own the product & UX:

  • Lead the end‑to‑end product design for Levity’s core product: from problem framing and flows to final UI.
  • Turn messy, real‑world automation use cases into clear, intuitive user journeys and interfaces.
  • Prototype and test with users to validate ideas quickly and iterate based on real feedback.
  • Work closely with Sebastian (CTO), engineers, GTM and solutions engineers to ensure what you design actually ships - and works.

Build systems, not one‑off:

  • Create and maintain a scalable design system (components, patterns, guidelines) that can grow with the product.
  • Ensure visual and UX consistency across product UI and other digital touchpoints (e.g. website, selected marketing surfaces).
  • Understand users deeply:
  • Run interviews, usability tests, and lightweight research with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Distill insights into clear problems, journeys, and opportunities for the product.
  • Champion the end user in discussions with engineering, solutions, and go‑to‑market teams.

Be AI‑first in both product & process:

  • Explore and design AI‑native interaction patterns (assistants, smart defaults, conversational flows, etc.).
  • Use modern AI tools in your own workflow to ideate, prototype, and ship faster.
  • Stay on top of what’s possible with AI and bring those ideas into Levity - both in the product and in how we work.


Your Experience & Background

  • ﻿5+ years of experience in product / UX design in a fast‑moving tech company, design agency, or startup.
  • A portfolio that shows you can:
  • Own complex product areas end‑to‑end (not just isolated UI work).
  • Turn complexity into simple, elegant flows and interfaces.
  • Strong product and UX thinking :
  • You challenge requirements, clarify problems, and propose better solutions.
  • You’re comfortable making trade‑offs between scope, speed, and polish.
  • Proven experience working very closely with engineers and product / solutions teams to get things shipped.
  • Experience can be from:
  • Strong product companies or PLG SaaS,
  • Agencies or freelance practice shipping complex digital products,
  • Design‑driven startups where you were close to engineering and founders.
  • B2C or consumer products with high UX and visual quality.
  • B2B SaaS with complex workflows and demanding users, with strong user-end focus. 
  • A genuinely fast, iterative way of working : You know when 80% is enough to learn and move.
  • Real curiosity for and engagement with AI tools and new design technologies : You actively experiment with them in your work.

title: Loss Prevetion Manager
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. ABOUT THE ROLE

Key Responsibilities

Risk Prevention & Incident Management

  • Identify and prevent risks and vulnerabilities at the earliest stage possible
  • Intervene in ongoing incidents to minimize impact and exposure
  • Lead thorough investigations of security-related incidents to identify root causes and prevent recurrence

Risk Assessment & Strategy

  • Evaluate threats, assess risks, and develop effective risk management strategies
  • Implement risk-based, balanced, and cost-effective security measures aligned with industry best practices

Security Operations & Compliance

  • Ensure consistent application of security and loss prevention standards across all operations
  • Maintain high levels of compliance with internal policies and external regulations
  • Oversee security practices across operations, infrastructure, administration, and support functions

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build trusted partnerships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Support and advise business units to enable safe and successful execution of operations and initiatives

Culture & Continuous Improvement

  • Promote security awareness and drive continuous improvement initiatives
  • Engage leadership and associates in strengthening security culture
  • Ensure a safe and secure working environment for all employees


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Security Management, Risk Management, Business Administration , or a related field (preferred)
  • Significant experience in loss prevention and security operations , ideally in a management role
  • Experience within distribution or logistics environments is highly desirable
  • Proven track record in developing, implementing, and managing loss prevention programs
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to gather and interpret data from multiple sources
  • Ability to assess situations holistically, considering all relevant facts and perspectives


CAREERS AT SHEIN


We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.


We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.


We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

title: [Tech] Especialista em Engenharia de Dados (REMOTO)
description:
A missão do Especialista em Engenharia de Dados será atuar na arquitetura, construção e evolução do Data Lake e dos produtos de dados desenvolvidos pelo time, incluindo soluções de Analytics, agentes e modelos de machine learning.


Trabalhará em conjunto com outro especialista de engenharia de dados na definição e implementação de arquiteturas, modelagem e disponibilização de dados em ambientes distribuídos, utilizando tecnologias como AWS, Spark, Trino e Athena, além de viabilizar o consumo eficiente dessas informações por ferramentas como o Metabase.


Será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados, garantindo performance, escalabilidade, qualidade e governança das informações. Espera-se que o profissional atue com alta autonomia técnica, contribuindo para decisões de arquitetura e para a evolução contínua do ecossistema de dados, assegurando que as soluções atendam às necessidades analíticas e de inteligência dos produtos com robustez e confiabilidade.

  • Atuar na construção e evolução da arquitetura do Data Lake e dos produtos de dados do time (Analytics, agentes e modelos);
  • Desenvolver, otimizar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e confiáveis em ambiente AWS;
  • Modelar e estruturar dados para consumo analítico e operacional, garantindo qualidade, performance e governança;
  • Definir padrões, arquiteturas e boas práticas de dados;
  • Implementar e otimizar consultas e camadas de acesso a dados utilizando Athena e Trino;
  • Processar e transformar grandes volumes de dados utilizando Spark;
  • Garantir a disponibilização eficiente de datasets para consumo em ferramentas analíticas como Metabase;
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, queries e tabelas no Data Lake;
  • Assegurar qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados ao longo de todo o pipeline;
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias de particionamento, versionamento e organização de dados;
  • Contribuir com a documentação técnica e evolução das boas práticas de engenharia de dados;
  • Acompanhar tendências e propor melhorias contínuas no ecossistema de dados e nas tecnologias


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de dados, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados em larga escala;
  • Domínio de SQL avançado para manipulação e otimização de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Experiência prática com processamento distribuído utilizando Spark;
  • Experiência com serviços de dados na AWS (ex: S3, Glue, Athena, IAM, entre outros);
  • Experiência com engines de consulta distribuída, como Athena e/ou Trino;
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como Código (Terraform)
  • Experiência em streaming de dados em tempo real (Apache Kafka)
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL), não relacionais (MongoDB) e vetoriais (Milvus, Pinecone, S3 Vector)
  • Experiência em governança de dados (Apache Ranger)
  • Conhecimento em Data lake/lakehouse moderno (Iceberg, PyIceberg)
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de qualidade, governança e organização de dados;
  • Experiência trabalhando em conjunto com times multidisciplinares (dados, produto e engenharia);
  • Capacidade de estruturar soluções de dados escaláveis e de alta performance.


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Experiência com disponibilização de dados para ferramentas de BI, como Metabase, Power BI ou Tableau;
  • Vivência com otimização de queries e particionamento de tabelas em Data Lake;
  • Experiência com orquestração de pipelines (ex: Airflow ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de Data Lake;
  • Experiência prévia suportando times de Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DataOps e observabilidade de pipelines;
  • Pós-graduação ou cursos especializados em Engenharia de Dados, Big Data ou Arquitetura de Dados.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Native Teams is a global platform for work payments and employment. Beyond managing payroll, compliance, and taxes, we integrate financial tools to maximise the value of every work payment, worldwide.


We are expanding our global team and looking for a Business Development Manager to bring their wider knowledge and help us get our product and service more widely known and used.


In this role, you will play a key role in driving new business and revenue growth by managing the full sales cycle from outbound outreach to discovery, solution design, negotiation, and closing. You will work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs, educate them on Native Teams' solutions, and guide them through the decision-making and onboarding process. Your goal is to acquire new customers and expand revenue within assigned markets and ICPs.


Would you like to take on a new challenge in the field of sales in a successful, fast-growing global start-up?


Location: Remote

Salary range: Flexible


Key Responsibilities


Outbound & Pipeline Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage prospective clients through outbound outreach, networking, events, and other channels.
  • Execute outbound strategies tailored to defined ICPs and market segments.
  • Research accounts for understanding business context, hiring plans, and potential use cases.


Inbound Handling

  • Take qualified inbound requests and convert them into active opportunities.
  • Respond promptly and professionally in line with internal SLAs.
  • Run a structured qualification to assess fit and readiness.


Discovery & Consultative Selling

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls to understand client goals, blockers, compliance considerations, and service requirements.
  • Educate prospects on how Native Teams supports global employment, payroll, and work payments.
  • Present tailored solutions, product overviews, and value propositions to multiple stakeholders.


Solution Design & Pricing

  • Prepare proposals, pricing scenarios, and competitive a/b options in line with commercial guidelines.
  • Guide clients on hiring models (EoR, Contractor of Record, etc.) and explain operational processes.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure feasibility for legal, product, and finance-related questions.


Negotiation & Closing

  • Manage contract negotiations and commercial discussions through to signature.
  • Navigate procurement timelines, internal approvals, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Close new business and achieve monthly/quarterly revenue targets.


Pipeline Ownership & Forecasting

  • Maintain an up-to-date sales pipeline with accurate stage management and forecasting.
  • Log all activities, updates, and communication history in the CRM.
  • Prioritize high-impact opportunities while balancing follow-ups and nurturing.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and Product teams to ensure a smooth client transition post-close.
  • Relay client feedback to internal stakeholders to support product and process improvements.
  • Represent the sales voice in outbound campaigns, ICP targeting, and revenue initiatives.


Market Feedback & Learning

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive offerings, and compliance developments.
  • Share insights from the market to improve positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
  • Experience in outbound sales, B2B sales, or full-cycle sales roles.
  • Strong communication and client-facing presentation skills.
  • Confident running discovery calls, demos, and negotiations.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot) and sales outreach tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deals in parallel.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, work autonomously, and drive outcomes.
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.



Benefits


  • Dynamic and interesting work in an early-stage, funded startup.
  • Ability to influence the next stages of our growth.
  • Experience working in the ever-changing world of FinTech.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.
  • Flexible work environment.



Join our team at Native Teams, a fast-growing global start-up. We're looking for driven, passionate individuals to join us as we continue to expand our reach and impact.


At Native Teams, we pride ourselves on our dynamic and supportive work environment, where we encourage personal and professional growth. We believe in hiring talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, not only because we should do it but because fresh perspectives improve our team and our decisions. Our multicultural team is made up of young, energetic, and positive people who are passionate about what they do.


As part of our team, you’ll reflect the people we serve and will have the opportunity to work with thousands and impact millions of lives around the world.


If you're looking for a challenging and rewarding career and the chance to be part of a team that's making a real difference in the world, then we want to hear from you.


Apply now to join the Native Teams family and take the first step toward a brighter future!

title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS [SAP SUCCESS FACTORS]
description:

Buscamos profissional para atuar na gestão funcional e governança do ecossistema SAP de RH, com foco em SAP SuccessFactors (lado cliente, sem acesso a provisioning), SAP HCM migrando para SAP S/4, garantindo sustentação, evolução e alinhamento estratégico das soluções.

title: Master Data Analyst
description:
Join our IT Master Data team and contribute to the reliability, integrity, and consistency of master data supporting the new Brazil operating model. As a Master Data Support Analyst, you will provide functional and technical Level 2 support on the Master Data Management (MDM) platform, focusing on maintaining referential data objects using the EBX tool and associated middleware layers. You will act as a key liaison between global MDM teams, shared services centers, and Brazil-based business stakeholders, ensuring compliance with corporate and local Data Governance rules and standards. In addition to Level 2 support, you will participate in operational data quality initiatives, continuous improvement efforts, and user training, collaborating across departments to support efficient business operations and sustained data excellence. Service is provided in English.

Your missions:

  • Investigate and resolve master data integration issues by conducting detailed root cause analysis and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Monitor overall data quality health and proactively propose, plan, and coordinate data cleansing campaigns aligned with Brazil-specific business rules and global data standards.
  • Perform advanced Level 2 troubleshooting, including middleware log analysis, payload simulation (SOAP UI, Postman), SQL querying, XML/JSON interpretation, and support of infrastructure operations when required.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for the EBX platform, providing guidance on configuration changes, enhancements, testing activities, and local customizations supporting the Brazil business model.
  • Enforce Data Governance rules and standards to ensure master data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems and functional domains.
  • Contribute to Non‑Regression Testing (NRT) campaigns, functional and integration testing, and continuous improvement initiatives linked to MDM processes and tooling.
  • Maintain, enhance, and document user guides, runbooks, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs); actively participate in or deliver training sessions to promote best practices and user adoption.
  • Provide regular reporting on issue status, data quality metrics, cleansing campaigns, and project progress to the Service Delivery Manager and relevant stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with key users across Accounting, Trading, Credit, and other business domains to understand requirements and translate them into scalable, compliant MDM solutions aligned with Brazil’s business strategy.
  • Interface effectively with Level 1 support teams, global MDM leads, IT teams, and outsourced partners to ensure smooth operations, timely issue resolution, and high‑quality service delivery.

Your profile:

  • Solid background in Master Data Management, data quality, or user support.
  • Strong understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) concepts.
  • Familiarity with middleware tools, SOAP UI, Postman, SQL, XML, and JSON troubleshooting.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex issues and synthesize actionable insights.
  • Academic background: supply chain management, logistics, business administration, finance, or equivalent.
  • English fluent. Portuguese is a plus.
  • Knowledge of SDLC of an application.
  • Awareness of Brazil-specific regulatory, tax, and data protection requirements and ability to apply them to MDM practices.
  • Experience with API testing tools (SOAP UI, Postman) for payload simulation and testing.
  • Experience running and analyzing SQL queries.
  • Experience reading and interpreting XML and JSON files.
  • Experience with MDM platforms and tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring logs and data flow in middleware and integration layers.
  • Experience with ITSM platforms such as Jira, ServiceNow (SNOW), or similar for incident and problem management.
  • Experience with MS Tools and manipulating and analyzing data with Excel.
  • You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, excellent communication skills, a self-driven and customer-focused attitude, agility in learning, sound decision-making capabilities, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. Flexibility to adapt to tight deadlines and a strong cross-cultural mindset for effective collaboration with global teams. Willingness to travel if necessary.

title: Coordenador(a) Manutenção Logística - Execução
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Desafio:


Coordenar as operações de manutenção automotiva logística, desde equipamentos de estradas, carregamento, transporte e pátio de madeira garantindo o cumprimento das metas operacionais, praticando segurança em todos os níveis de operação, garantindo a conformidade legal e a excelência no atendimento ao cliente interno, assegurando previsibilidade no estoque de produtos, organização e padrão de qualidade.


Principais Atividades:


  • Coordenar as atividades operacionais da manutenção logística (Realização das preventivas, corretivas, preditivas, inspeções, etc);
  • Gerenciar equipes de mecânicos, eletricistas, borracheiros e público operacional manutenção e auxiliares, incluindo escala, desempenho, treinamentos e 5S;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, meio ambiente e legislação vigente;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (Backlog, aderência a preventiva, DM, MTTR, MTBF, etc);
  • Criar procedimentos operacionais que contemplem todas as operações e riscos da área;
  • Coordenar todo estoque de peças das operações e realização de inventario;
  • Atuar na prevenção de fraudes, desvios e inconformidades operacionais;
  • Garantir o correto funcionamento dos equipamentos de apoio (Caminhão oficina, pipa, comboio etc.);
  • Implementar sistemas de gestão operacionais, interface com sistemas de gestão da empresa;
  • Realizar interface com PCM para garantir aderência ao plano estratégico da área;

title: Live Streaming Internship
description:
Location : Remote

Type : Academy Internship Programme

Duration : 3 to 6 months


City Explorer is a media and technology organisation focused on real time video content and digital engagement.


City Explorer Academy provides structured training in livestreaming, video production, content creation, and digital marketing. This internship is designed for individuals who are interested in developing skills in live video broadcasting and content development.


Programme Fee

Participation in the City Explorer Academy involves a one-time programme fee that supports the training, mentorship, equipment, sponsored travel in the second phase of the programme, and access to the livestreaming platform throughout the internship.


Internship Duration Options

• 3-month internship: Includes the full 3-month Academy training period.

• 4 to 6-month internship: Includes the 3-month Academy training period followed by international livestream assignments for selected participants.


Training Structure during the First 3 Months

• Unit 1: Live Streaming and Video Content

• Unit 2: Creative Content Creation

• Unit 3: Social Media and Marketing


During the training period, interns will attend online sessions, complete assessments, livestream a minimum of 5 hours per week, follow City Explorer guidelines, and participate in content planning activities.


International Assignments

Interns who join the 4 to 6-month route and successfully complete the initial 3 months may be selected for international livestream assignments. City Explorer will cover travel, accommodation, and meals during these assignments. Additional coaching will be provided to help interns apply their training in real world environments.


Progression

High performing interns may be considered for future opportunities within the organisation.


How to Apply

Click the Apply Now button and complete the application process through this platform.

City Explorer is committed to providing equal opportunities and supports a diverse and inclusive working environment.

Pesquisa e Inovação


• Avaliar novas tecnologias, frameworks e ferramentas de MLOps.

title: Coordenador de Pré-Vendas e Soluções
description:
Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Negócios (Pré-Vendas e Parcerias) que será responsável por apoiar o desenvolvimento de oportunidades estratégicas por meio da estruturação de propostas técnico-comerciais e da construção de soluções em conjunto com as áreas internas e parceiros externos.

A posição atuará como ponto de integração entre as áreas de negócios, operações, financeiro, jurídico e demais áreas corporativas, garantindo que as propostas apresentadas aos clientes estejam consistentes, economicamente viáveis e alinhadas à estratégia de crescimento da GIF.

Também terá papel relevante no desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas e na construção de soluções integradas com empresas (parceiros) que complementem nosso portfólio de soluções, ampliando a capacidade de entrega e geração de valor para os clientes.

Adicionalmente, será responsável por aprimorar os processos da área de negócios relacionados à gestão de oportunidades, propostas comerciais e atividades de pré-vendas, garantindo padronização das informações, organização no CRM e maior eficiência na construção das ofertas.


Conheça nossa história:


A nossa história começa em 1994, na Argentina, quando a GIF se estabeleceu como fornecedora estratégica para empresas. Na mesma época, houve uma expansão comercial significativa, que foi acompanhada por um aumento de casos de fraudes. Foi nesse momento que assumimos a responsabilidade de garantir a segurança das empresas e entramos em ação.


Ao longo desses quase 30 anos, a GIF tem trabalhado incansavelmente na prevenção, detecção e combate às fraudes corporativas. Uma história marcada por confiança, dedicação, colaboração, transparência e respeito.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Interagir com clientes para compreender necessidades e requisitos das oportunidades, contribuindo para a construção de soluções aderentes às demandas apresentadas.
  • Conduzir RFPs e processos concorrenciais complexos, avaliando as oportunidades e apoiando as áreas internas na estruturação das propostas técnico-comerciais.
  • Desenvolver apresentações executivas e materiais de suporte às propostas.
  • Definir modelos de precificação considerando custos, riscos e viabilidade operacional. Organizar e consolidar propostas técnico-comerciais com escopo, modelo operacional e racional de custos para envio de propostas.
  • Apoiar a formalização de contratos, aditivos e acordos comerciais.
  • Melhorar os fluxos dos processos de pré-vendas e elaboração de propostas.
  • Estruturar e fazer gestão de parcerias técnicas e comerciais com empresas que complementem nosso ecossistema de soluções.
  • Garantir que as informações das oportunidades em CRM (Pipedrive) e ferramentas de gestão (Monday) estejam atualizadas e corretas.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de pré-vendas, elaboração de propostas e gestão de oportunidades.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em estruturação de propostas técnico-comerciais para clientes B2B.
  • Capacidade de análise e interpretação de RFPs e documentos de contratação complexos.
  • Experiência na construção de racional de custos e apoio à definição de preços de propostas.
  • Conhecimento em processos de pré-vendas e desenvolvimento de soluções consultivas.
  • Experiência na elaboração de apresentações executivas e materiais de propostas.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de pipeline de oportunidades e uso de ferramentas de CRM.
  • Experiência na articulação entre áreas internas para construção de soluções integradas.
  • Experiência em gestão de modelos de negócios com parceiros externos.
  • Conhecimento em indicadores e análises de desempenho comercial.
  • Atuação prévia com parcerias estratégicas e ecossistemas de soluções integradas.



Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL (para análise e consolidação de dados).
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão comercial (Monday, HubSpot, Salesforce etc.).

Formação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Física ou áreas correlatas

Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de prompts e agentes de IA utilizando sistemas baseados em LLMs

Domínio de Python

Conhecimento do mercado de crédito ou produtos financeiros

What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

title: Media Tech Support
description:
Work Mode: Remote

Location: Costa Rica / Mexico / Brazil


Role Overview

We are seeking a Media Tech Support professional to support file-based media workflows in a dynamic and global environment.

This role is responsible for handling support requests, collaborating with engineering teams to resolve issues, validating solutions, and maintaining accurate technical documentation.

The ideal candidate is highly self-sufficient, capable of working independently, and committed to delivering high-quality support and excellent customer experience. Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts are essential.

  • Act as the main point of contact for media technology support issues

  • Create and maintain documentation, including runbooks and escalation procedures

  • Understanding of frame rates, resolutions, scan types, and color spaces

Systems & Tools

  • Experience with Linux and Windows Server
  • Familiarity with Jira and Slack
  • Experience working in customer support or service-oriented environments
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills

Automation & Integration

  • Experience manipulating video, audio, and subtitles via APIs, JSON, or command line
  • Proficiency in creating or modifying JSON/XML workflows for transcoding and QC
  • Understanding of API protocols

Cloud

  • Experience working with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Ability to operate and test systems in cloud-based environments (Linux/Windows instances)

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities
  • Ability to work in high-pressure, fast-paced environments


Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud-based transcoding systems
  • Knowledge of AWS architecture and Well-Architected Framework
  • Scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, Perl, or Ruby)
  • Experience with subtitle and caption formats (SRT, VTT, IMSC, TTML, etc.)

  • Knowledge of shared storage systems (NAS or object storage)
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Experience working with global teams


Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience or equivalent academic experience in media workflows
  • Technical certifications are a plus

title: QA/QC Manager – Data Centers
description:
The Client


Datacenter People is working with the largest building commissioning and operational risk management providers in the world.


What the Job Involves…

  • Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its core values.
  • Performs quality inspections in accordance with program quality control documentation. Participate and guide project quality control from kick-off until hand-off.
  • Provides oversight of the implementation of the QA/QC management system at site.
  • Coordinates the quality inspections with the site sub-contractors and vendors.
  • Coordinates with the customers representative on all quality matters.

  • Verifies that the quality related site activities are in accordance with the design documents and program standards.

  • Completes and coordinates the approval of the sites QC technical submittals to the customer.
  • Coordinates with the Client and Contractor QA/QC team on all quality issues.
  • Coordinate and chair the QA/QC site weekly meetings with the Contractor QC personnel.
  • Assures all technical documents relative to site quality control are of current status.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Data center commissioning/QA experience.
  • Has a Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline preferred.
  • Has Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, Quality Auditor, and/or Quality Engineer a plus.
  • Is experienced with ISO 9001 certification process.
  • Has a history and experience driving improved Quality at scale.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Remote
description:

- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

Diferenciais

• Experiência prévia em consultoria em empresas de serviços profissionais.

title: Analista Ambiental | Socioambiental
description:
Sobre a VSZ


A Ventos de São Zacarias é uma empresa de geração de energia renovável no Nordeste do Brasil, comprometido com as melhores práticas ambientais, sociais e de governança (ESG), alinhado a referenciais internacionais como Padrões de Desempenho do IFC e Princípios do Equador.

Nosso compromisso é gerar energia limpa promovendo desenvolvimento sustentável e relações transparentes e duradouras com as comunidades locais.


Propósito da Posição


O(a) Analista Ambiental terá papel fundamental na gestão técnica e implementação do Plano de Gestão Ambiental e Social (PBA) na fase de operação do Complexo Eólico, assegurando a governança do atendimento às condicionantes ambientais, a conformidade regulatória e o monitoramento sistemático do desempenho ambiental.

Atuará como interface técnica junto a órgãos ambientais, comunidades locais, proprietários de terra e demais partes interessadas, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos socioambientais e para a consolidação da estratégia da empresa.


Principais Responsabilidades


1️⃣ Implementação de Programas Socioambientais

  • Atuar na gestão técnica e estratégica dos processos de licenciamento ambiental (LP, LI, LO e renovações), incluindo interface com órgãos ambientais, análise de riscos e definição de estratégias regulatórias, tanto para o Complexo Eólico em operação quanto para novos desenvolvimentos.
  • Planejar, estruturar e monitorar o atendimento às condicionantes ambientais, propondo soluções viáveis e ambientalmente eficazes e assegurando rastreabilidade e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Executar, supervisionar e orientar os Planos e Programas previstos no PBA, garantindo conformidade legal e regulatória.
  • Prestar suporte técnico em temas ambientais do Complexo Eólico, incluindo monitoramento de efluentes, potabilidade, gestão de resíduos, controle de emissões atmosféricas, controle de processos erosivos, acompanhamento do PRAD, reposição florestal e compromissos associados a plano de manejo de RPPN.
  • Realizar inspeções ambientais preventivas com foco na identificação de aspectos e impactos, mitigação de riscos e prevenção de passivos ambientais.
  • Acompanhar tecnicamente atividades e intervenções em campo no âmbito do Complexo Eólico.

title: GLOBAL STRATEGIC ACCOUNT MANAGER DIRECTOR
description:
Work in your element

At Oleon, we bring you natural chemistry. Ambitious, with both feet on the ground. That's who we are and that's how we will continue to grow. Our specialty lies in converting natural fats and oils into a wide range of oleochemical products. We offer them in a large variety of markets such as: cosmetics, nutrition, crop protection, industrial ingredients, lubricants, oilfield, coatings, detergents, and many more.

Oleon has over 1,000 employees worldwide in 10 different countries. Enthusiastic people who are completely in their element here at Oleon are more than welcome to join our team!


The job

At Oleon, building strong and long-term partnerships with our most strategic customers is a key driver of sustainable growth. As GLOBAL STRATEGIC ACCOUNT DIRECTOR , you are responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Oleon’s most important accounts while strengthening our customer intimacy approach across the organization.

You lead our team of global strategic account managers (6) and ensure a structured and strategic approach to managing our A-account portfolio. By developing and overseeing global strategic account plans, you translate customer insights, market dynamics, and long-term partnership opportunities into clear commercial priorities and growth initiatives.

In this role, you act as a central connector across regions, business units, and functions. You align commercial strategy with innovation, operations, and marketing to ensure that Oleon delivers consistent and value-driven solutions to its key customers worldwide.

You also provide leadership and direction to global account teams, strengthening collaboration across affiliates and supporting teams in complex customer environments and strategic negotiations. As a coach and functional leader, you help elevate our global strategic account management capabilities and foster a culture focused on partnership, value creation, and long-term impact.

Through your leadership, you ensure that Oleon continues to strengthen its position as a trusted strategic partner for its most important global customers while accelerating sustainable and profitable growth.

You also lead our global team of inside sales representatives (15). This team manages Oleon’s D-accounts, in an efficient and successful manner. You set out a clear pricing strategy for these accounts and monitor the results. You also introduce product or market campaigns to help this team in their prospection efforts. As coach you help them to potentially grow into an account manager role.


Who are we looking for?

You'll succeed if:

  • You hold a master’s degree in business, engineering, economics, or a related field.
  • You have at least 10 years of experience in international B2B sales, strategic account management, or commercial leadership roles, ideally within a chemical, industrial, or manufacturing environment.
  • You have proven experience managing global strategic accounts and developing long-term partnerships with multinational customers.
  • You demonstrate strong leadership and coaching capabilities, enabling you to guide international and cross-functional teams towards shared objectives.
  • You possess excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, allowing you to interact confidently with senior leadership and executive-level customers.
  • You combine a strategic mindset with a pragmatic and results-oriented approach.
  • You are internationally minded, mobile, and willing to travel up to 30% of your time.
  • Fluent proficiency in English is essential, while proficiency in French or Dutch is a plus.



Next to your skills, it is your drive and motivation that will make all the difference!


What's in it for you?

Your benefits:

You will join a company with ambitious goals and a welcoming atmosphere. Both your personal development and work-life balance are equally important to us. You can expect an attractive salary and leave scheme, along with numerous benefits such as meal vouchers, CAO90, company car etc. Additionally, we provide a solid insurance plan that you can rely on.


Oleon is dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment that embraces all forms of diversity. We ensure equal opportunities in our recruitment and integration processes and ensure that you can be yourself in our professional environment.

title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.


You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.g., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.


Strategic Importance


  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it’s about impact and influence across the business.



Key Responsibilities


  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.


Promotion & Trade Effectiveness


  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.


Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy


  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.


Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:


  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk


Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support


  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.


Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.


Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:


  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations


Executive Storytelling & Data Communication


  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.


Required Experience & Skills


Experience


  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.


Proven track record with:


  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment


Technical Skills


  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks


Capabilities


  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives


Preferred Experience


  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

This job requires up to 25% global travel.

title: DevOps Sr
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar como DevOps, no ICC SOFT.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar a atualização de sistemas (deployment) utilizando tecnologia específica do projeto;
  • Desenvolver scripts de alta complexidade para automatização de deployment do projeto ou qualquer outra tarefa que o projeto julgue necessária sua automatização;
  • Realizar monitoramento de sistemas e aplicações utilizando tecnologia definida no projeto, analisar de a alta complexidade em dados obtidos, e realizar configurações complexas na ferramenta;

  • Utilizar plataformas de computação em nuvem e provisionar recursos e serviços básicos de cloud, de forma manual e automatizada;

  • Documentar processos e soluções técnicas de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes críticos de software e infraestrutura no sistema;
  • Realizar automatização de processo de Build;
  • Analisar e isolar o defeito apontado no processo de testes da solução, bem como identificar a causa raiz e propor uma solução a fim de atender aos processos de qualidade de software;
  • Criar documentações complementares de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Aplicar novos procedimentos de desenvolvimento de software, conforme necessidade, descrevendo métodos e operacionalização dos mesmos, em sequência padronizada, de acordo com o sistema de qualidade assegurada, a fim de buscar melhorias contínuas;

Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Forte compreensão de arquiteturas nativas de nuvem (cloud-native), incluindo Kubernetes, microsserviços e malha de serviços (service mesh);


Domínio em:

  • Ferramentas para deployment (ex: Jenkings, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Travis CI, Salt),
  • Plataformas de computação em nuvem (ex: AWS, Openstack, Google Cloud),

  • Automatização de cloud (ex: Terraform, Cloud Formation),
  • Infraestrutura como Código,
  • Linguagem de programação para automatização de testes (ex: Selenium, Javascript, Phanton JS, Casper JS),

Conhecimentos em:

  • Ferramentas Grafana, Graphite, ELK,
  • Utilização de container Docker, Kubernetes, Gerenciamento de ambiente Linux,
  • Banco de Dados (Ex: SQL Server, MySQL, Cassandra) SQL/NoSQL, consulta e criação de tabelas/esquemas/scripts,
  • Métodos de desenvolvimento de sistemas (Ex: Scrum) e ferramenta de controle (EX: Jira);


Noções sobre Segurança e Vulnerabilidade (Ex. SQL injection, cross-site scripting, CSRF, SSL, etc);

title: Analista de Planejamento e Análise Financeira | FP&A
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.


Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!


Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de ANALISTA DE PLANEJAMENTO E ANÁLISE FINANCEIRA (FP&A) abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso:


Sua missão:

  • Elaboração e acompanhamento de budget e forecast;

  • Estudos de viabilidade financeira e modelagem de cenários;
  • Apoio no fechamento mensal com foco analítico;
  • Monitoramento de KPIs financeiros e operacionais;
  • Integração com áreas como Controladoria, Contabilidade e Negócios.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Engenharias, Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas afins;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em FP&A ou funções similares;
  • Bom conhecimento em contabilidade e finanças corporativas;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas semelhantes;
  • Será um diferencial vivência no Agronegócio.

title: Coordenador(a) de Compras - Negócio Madeiras

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer with deep expertise in Large Language Model integration and production AI systems. This role will lead the design and implementation of LLM-powered capabilities within our platform, working closely with backend, mobile, and product teams.

This individual will own the end-to-end AI architecture, from model selection and prompt strategy to retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, cost optimization, and production deployment.

This is not a research role. It is a systems architecture and applied AI engineering role focused on building scalable, secure, real-world AI applications.

Key Responsibilities

LLM Architecture & Integration

  • Design and implement LLM-powered application workflows
  • Architect prompt orchestration, tool calling, and multi-step reasoning pipelines
  • Define model selection strategy (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, etc.)
  • Implement streaming responses for mobile and web clients
  • Optimize token usage and latency for production environments
  • Build fallback and resilience strategies across model providers

RAG & Knowledge Systems

  • Architect retrieval-augmented generation pipelines
  • Design vector database schema and embedding workflows
  • Implement chunking, metadata tagging, and indexing strategies
  • Optimize semantic search relevance
  • Integrate structured and unstructured data sources

AI Infrastructure & Backend Integration

  • Collaborate with backend architects to integrate AI services into APIs
  • Design asynchronous processing pipelines for AI workflows
  • Implement caching strategies for inference results
  • Architect evaluation and monitoring frameworks for LLM output quality
  • Build guardrails, moderation layers, and output validation

Model Evaluation & Performance

  • Define evaluation metrics for response quality
  • Implement automated testing for LLM outputs
  • Analyze hallucination patterns and mitigation techniques
  • Monitor drift, cost, and performance metrics
  • Continuously improve prompt and architecture strategies

Security & Governance

  • Implement data privacy safeguards
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise security requirements
  • Design safe handling of user-generated content
  • Implement access control and audit logging

Technical Leadership

  • Guide LLM architecture decisions across the platform
  • Mentor engineers working on AI-related components
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and frameworks
  • Define long-term AI roadmap aligned with product strategy

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years in software engineering with at least 2+ years focused on LLM systems
  • Production experience integrating LLM APIs
  • Strong experience with:
  • Python (FastAPI preferred)
  • Vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
  • Embeddings and semantic search
  • Prompt engineering and tool invocation workflows
  • Experience building RAG systems in production
  • Experience optimizing latency and inference costs
  • Strong understanding of tokenization, context windows, and model limitations
  • Experience deploying AI services in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks
  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks
  • Experience with evaluation tooling and benchmarking
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning or model adaptation techniques
  • Experience building AI features for mobile-first applications

title: Lead React Native Engineer
description:
We’re hiring our first mobile engineer in São Paulo to own the React Native app end to end and partner directly with the founder on product, architecture, and user experience.


Company Description

Glitch is building the personal AI trading assistant. Think ChatGPT for financial markets.


We believe the era of scrolling through trading apps is ending. The future is a personal AI companion that knows your goals, watches the markets while you sleep, and helps you build wealth across prediction markets, crypto, stocks, and everything in between.


We're a small, scrappy team, backed by leading U.S. investors, and looking to build a base in São Paulo. We ship fast, have a vision for the future, and obsess over craft. If you've ever wished financial tools felt more like the best consumer apps on your phone and less like a Bloomberg Terminal, this is your opportunity to build it.


Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for a Lead React Native Engineer based in São Paulo, Brazil. You'll be the founding mobile engineer at Glitch, the person who owns the iOS and Android experience end to end. This isn't a \"ticket-taker\" role.


We want someone product-oriented who brings strong ideas for features and improvements, not just someone implementing tickets. You'll be building new kinds of mobile interfaces for AI products: dynamic surfaces, conversational workflows, and composable UI systems that can adapt to user context in real time.


If you are an active trader of prediction markets, crypto, or stocks, that’s a huge plus.


Day to day, you'll be:

  • Owning the architecture and development of our React Native app end to end, and defining the foundation we build on as the product evolves.
  • Designing fluid, animated interactions that make the AI feel like a living presence, not a text box
  • Implementing real-time data feeds, push notifications, and background processing for market alerts
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction. Your opinions on UX matter here, not just your code
  • Building composable UI primitives (cards, charts, widgets) that our AI agent can dynamically assemble into personalized interfaces
  • Using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to move at the pace of a full engineering team, even when you’re building solo
  • Shipping to TestFlight and the App Store, managing releases, and iterating fast based on user feedback
  • Integrating with crypto wallets, onchain transactions, and Web3 infrastructure


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of production React Native experience (or React + strong mobile interest; convince us)
  • You've shipped at least one app that real humans use and love. Show us
  • Deep comfort with TypeScript, modern React patterns (hooks, context, concurrent features), and state management
  • Experience with animations and gesture handling (Reanimated, Gesture Handler). You care about the 60fps details
  • Strong CS fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, system design. You can think, not just implement
  • Experience with real-time data (WebSockets, SSE, polling) and push notifications
  • Comfort with backend integration: REST APIs, GraphQL, authentication flows
  • Proficient with AI coding tools to increase productivity (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor)
  • Bonus: crypto/Web3 experience (wallets, transactions, onchain data)
  • Bonus: experience building chat interfaces, AI-powered UIs, or streaming LLM responses
  • Bonus: an eye for design. You notice when padding is off by 4px and it bothers you
  • Bonus: familiarity with native modules and bridging when React Native isn't enough


Who You Are

  • Scrappy. You'd rather ship something imperfect today than architect the perfect system for a month. You can go from zero to prototype in a weekend
  • Opinionated about craft. You have taste. You've used an app and thought \"this animation is wrong\" and you could explain why. You care about the details that make software feel good
  • Excited about the frontier. AI-native interfaces, prediction markets, crypto — this isn't a job where you maintain a CRUD app. The product we're building barely has precedent.
  • Low-ego, high-output. Small team. Everyone does everything. You'll pair with the founder, debate product decisions, and push code in the same afternoon
  • Builder energy. You make things on the side. You have a GitHub with projects. You get excited about new libraries and try them at 2am. You can't help it


Why Glitch

  • Compensation. R$25,000–R$35,000 BRL/month + meaningful early-stage equity, depending on experience and scope.
  • High ownership, high standards. This is an early-stage company with a fast pace and a high bar for craft, judgment, and execution. It’s a great fit for someone who wants outsized responsibility and rapid growth.
  • Founding team. You will be one of the first employees. Your fingerprints will be on everything
  • São Paulo-based. In-person, high-bandwidth collaboration. We build together
  • Meaningful equity. Early-stage with significant ownership. We’re focused on building a product people love, not chasing short-term metrics
  • Work on hard problems. AI-generated interfaces, real-time market data, crypto integration, mobile-native design, all in one product
  • Ship constantly. We deploy daily. You'll see your work in users' hands fast


How To Apply

Send us a note with your GitHub (or portfolio), a link to an app you’ve shipped, what you personally owned (e.g., key features, architecture, performance work, release process), and one product decision you’d improve in a mobile app you love (and why). Also, please tell us why this role at Glitch specifically. We read every application.

title: Analista de Growth Pleno — Jornada do Cliente & Conversão (ChatBot WhatsApp)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ


Remoto


A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.


O Papel

O Analista de Growth Pleno será o principal responsável pela jornada do cliente no chatbot do WhatsApp, o maior canal de aquisição e relacionamento da empresa. A missão é clara: reduzir atrito, combater o abandono e maximizar o Lifetime Value (LTV) da base de leads e clientes.


Responsabilidades

  • Mapear e otimizar o funil conversacional de ponta a ponta, identificando gargalos nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups e arquitetura dos fluxos.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios e campanhas de reengajamento.
  • Auxiliar na construção de dashboards de acompanhamento da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados (Snowflake, Power BI).
  • Refinar clusters de audiência para personalização em escala.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com os times de Marketing, Vendas, BI e Produto/Tech.


KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Capacidade técnica de uso ou criação de agentes de IA, independentemente da ferramenta ou framework (Claude, Manus, Antigravity…).
  • Experiência sólida como Analista de Growth, CRO, Lifecycle Marketing, CRM ou Produto, com foco em conversão.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada: métricas de funil, análise de cohort, LTV e CAC.
  • Vivência prática com otimização de chatbots, automação de mensagens e WhatsApp API oficial.
  • Domínio de frameworks de growth hacking e testes A/B.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Boa comunicação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócios.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, mercado de crédito ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Conhecimento na plataforma ColmeIA ou chats conversacionais similares.
  • Habilidades em SQL e ferramentas como Metabase ou Supabase.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização de fluxos conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.


Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável.
